resources.string: Enter your PIN using whole digits 0–9 only — no decimal point, operators, or functions. Then press and hold =.
Enter your operator sequence using only + − × ÷ ^ (at least one; repeats are allowed, e.g. × × ÷ ÷). Then press and hold =.
That isn\'t a valid PIN. Use whole digits 0–9 only — no decimal point, operators, or functions — then press and hold =.
No operators entered. Add at least one of + − × ÷ ^ after the digits, then press and hold =.
Only operators (+ − × ÷ ^) belong in the sequence. Press and hold = when the sequence is complete.
That didn\'t match your first entry. Enter the same digits and the same operator sequence both times.
